The maximum is $k = 14$. The upper bound is proved below. I did not complete an explicit placement achieving it, so tightness rests on a partial check and my recollection that this is the known answer.

I read "each rook only attacks rooks of the opposite color" to mean that the nearest rook in each of the four directions from any rook has the opposite color. So along any row or column the colors alternate.

**Upper bound.** Take a row with $b$ black rooks and $w$ white rooks. The colors alternate along the row, so $w \le b+1$. This holds even when $b=0$, since then $w\le 1$. Summing over all 8 rows gives
$$k \le 6 + 8 = 14.$$

**Attainability.** Equality needs $w = b+1$ in every row and every column. A natural configuration puts the 6 black rooks in 6 distinct rows and 6 distinct columns, each with a white rook on both sides in its row and in its column. The two black-free rows and the two black-free columns then hold one white rook each, which brings the total to 14. I checked that the counting is consistent for this configuration, but I did not construct the placement explicitly.

ANSWER: 14
